paper_id: Robustifying Learning-Augmented Caching Efficiently without Compromising 1-Consistency
title: Robustifying Learning-Augmented Caching Efficiently without Compromising 1-Consistency
motivation: Learning-augmented caching achieves ideal 1-consistency but lacks robustness; existing robustification sacrifices consistency or incurs excessive overhead
problem_framing: Online caching minimization under limited cache size; enhance robustness of 1-consistent algorithms while preserving optimal performance under perfect predictions
key_insight: Guard pages only upon detected prediction errors using lightweight phase-based mechanism, avoiding costly recomputation while preserving 1-consistency
method_signature: GUARD framework with phase-based error detection and guard mechanism, O(1) per-request overhead
evaluation_criteria: Consistency (competitive ratio under perfect predictions), robustness (bound under arbitrary errors), smoothness (degradation with prediction errors)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: F&R and F&R (FITF) incur O(n² log k) overhead due to recomputing optimal solution; marking-based methods restrict attaining 1-consistency
evidence_for_taste: lacks robustness: it can perform arbitrarily worse when predictions are inaccurate
this introduces a multiplicative factor of 2 in the robustness guarantees
its overhead is prohibitive for real-time use
may prevent necessary evictions that would otherwise be justified by accurate predictions
overly aggressive random evictions may lead to a long eviction chain
thinking_moves: 观察到immediate protection损害一致性，从全局相位视角重新设计保护时机
从昂贵的显式错误检测（重算OPT）转向利用最优驱逐内在模式的隐式检测
把预测驱动驱逐限制在guarded/un-guarded集合上，实现一致性保持
通过eviction chain分析建立随机驱逐的概率上界，连接smoothness与inversions
承认过度保护的问题，转而只在证据显示错误时才介入
